lead_raw_text:
The structure of NaCeCl₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms (Na₄Ce₄Cl₁₂) distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers coordinated by nine Cl neighbors, while Na centers have nine Cl neighbors each; Cl environments range from three- to five-coordinate geometries involving Ce and Na. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Cl-centered polyhedra and Ce- or Na-centered polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Na-centered polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
